verdict.rationale: Khoj's setup docs have provider API keys supplied as server environment variables (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY), so credentials are kept in env config rather than entered in chat. Nothing in the evidence shows redaction, a secrets store, or any safeguard against keys being pasted into chat history. missing for 10: documented redaction of secrets in chat or logs, a secrets store or vault integration, safeguards preventing keys from entering chat history, independent corroboration of credential handling.

support.subject: As a security engineer, credentials are handled deliberately — a secrets store or env separation with redaction, never API keys pasted into chat history

citations.quote: Set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY to your API key if you want to use OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini commercial chat models
